entries.title: Read filesystem
entries.description: Reads files, directories, metadata, or file content.

entries.title: Write filesystem
entries.description: Creates, edits, moves, deletes, formats, or otherwise writes files.

entries.title: Spawn process
entries.description: Starts subprocesses, shell commands, build scripts, test runners, or tool plugins.

entries.title: Network access
entries.description: Uses the network, downloads dependencies, calls APIs, or contacts external services.

entries.title: Read environment
entries.description: Reads environment variables, system configuration, or process state.

entries.title: Write environment
entries.description: Changes environment variables, shell profile, registry settings, or process configuration.

entries.title: Install dependency
entries.description: Installs, restores, updates, vendors, or resolves dependencies.

entries.title: Read database
entries.description: Reads from a local or remote database.

entries.title: Write database
entries.description: Writes to a local or remote database, including migrations.

entries.title: Call service
entries.description: Calls a local or remote service, daemon, cloud API, or agent.

entries.title: Read credential
entries.description: Reads secrets, tokens, certificates, keys, or credential stores.

entries.title: Write secret
entries.description: Creates, modifies, deletes, or rotates secrets or credentials.

entries.title: Run container
entries.description: Builds or runs a container, sandbox, VM, or isolated runtime.

entries.title: Read VCS
entries.description: Reads version-control status, history, remotes, branches, or metadata.

entries.title: Write VCS
entries.description: Stages, commits, tags, rebases, pushes, checks out, or otherwise mutates version control state.
